metadata.question: Are there more red flowers visible on April 21, 2018, than on May 7, 2018, in Keukenhof Garden in the Netherlands?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Keukenhof Garden, Netherlands (approximately 52.27°N, 4.46°E) - Dates: April 21, 2018 vs. May 7, 2018 - Dataset: Sentinel-2 (high resolution, suitable for flower detection) - Need to detect red flowers, which have high red channel values and low green/blue 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Cloud masking is critical for accurate flower detection - Use SCL (Scene Classification Layer) to mask clouds and shadows - Red flowers will have high red reflectance (NIR/Red ratio not suitable here; instead use red band intensity) 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): If we have valid pixels but red flower count/intensity is genuinely lower on one date - Null/Error (C): If no images exist (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), or calculation returns invalid values (C3) - Define "red flowers": pixels with Red > 0.3 and Red > Green and Red > Blue (simple red detection) - Compare the mean red reflectance or count of red pixels between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Keukenhof Garden geometry const keukenhof = ee.Geometry.Point([4.46, 52.27]).buffer(500); // 500m buffer around center // Define time periods const date1_start = '2018-04-15'; const date1_end = '2018-04-25'; const date2_start = '2018-05-01'; const date2_end = '2018-05-15'; // Function to mask clouds using SCL const maskClouds = (image) => { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const cloudMask = scl.lt(4).or(scl.gt(8)); // Mask clouds, shadows, snow return image.updateMask(cloudMask); }; // Function to detect red flowers: high red reflectance const detectRedFlowers = (image) => { const red = image.select('B4'); const green = image.select('B3'); const blue = image.select('B2'); const redFlower = red.gt(0.2).and(red.gt(green)).and(red.gt(blue)); return image.addBands(redFlower.rename('red_flowers')); }; // Collect Sentinel-2 images for April 21, 2018 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(keukenhof) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2018 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Collect Sentinel-2 images for May 7, 2018 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(keukenhof) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2018 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Process April images col1 = col1.map(maskClouds).map(detectRedFlowers); const img1 = col1.median(); // Process May images col2 = col2.map(maskClouds).map(detectRedFlowers); const img2 = col2.median(); // Calculate red flower statistics for April const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: keukenhof, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const redMean1 = stats1['B4_mean'] || 0; const count1 = stats1['B4_count'] || 0; // Calculate red flower statistics for May const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: keukenhof, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const redMean2 = stats2['B4_mean'] || 0; const count2 = stats2['B4_count'] || 0; console.log(`April 21 Red Mean: ${redMean1?.toFixed(3)} Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`May 7 Red Mean: ${redMean2?.toFixed(3)} Pixels: ${count2}`); // Validate results if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (redMean1 === null || redMean2 === null || isNaN(redMean1) || isNaN(redMean2)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare red flower intensity if (redMean1 > redMean2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
